title: Startup, sign-in and ChatGPT fixes
summary: Fixes for ChatGPT, DeepSeek, startup and sign-in problems found since 1.24.30, plus a guest mode.
added: Guest mode: if a profile can't be created, "Use PlazCode as a guest" keeps your settings, skills and memory on this computer, separate from online profiles.
Safer file work: the AI can use paths inside your project and preview files read-only.
Memory notes are loaded only when they are relevant, and AI results use one standard shape.
Command batches use one call shape, and the AI is told which capabilities are granted.
improved: Windows startup errors now name the folder and the missing file, and the Mac check matches the real app layout.
Slow Blender scenes get more time, and long single-line edits are handled in safe pieces.
fixed: ChatGPT: startup no longer hangs on "Starting Up" or "Send paused", including in Work mode.
ChatGPT: typing freezes, false "sent" confirmations and lost tool results.
Leftover startup text no longer stays in the message box.
The screenshot pop-up no longer shows a black box.
DeepSeek: false startup warnings, stuck sends and broken line breaks.
Sign-up and log-in recover from busy or offline servers; saved logins stay usable.
Windows: false "program files changed" startup error, and Windows paths inside the project.
Ox Alpha: Copy is no longer counted as a message sent.
The AI keeps working on your project after short follow-ups.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
